class.name: VECSSystem
class.brief_description: Base class for ECS systems, ticked by the scheduler.
class.description:
[b]VECSSystem[/b] is the base class for game logic that runs over the ECS world. Register an instance with [method VECSWorld.add_system] and tick its group with [method VECSWorld.process].
Two authoring styles coexist: - [b]GDScript systems[/b] override [method _script_process] and reach the world through [method get_world_node] using the script API. - [b]C++ systems[/b] (compiled into the extension) override the C++ virtuals [code]_setup[/code], [code]_tick[/code] and [code]_deps[/code] for zero-Variant hot paths.
The scheduler respects [member group], [member active], [member paused], [member tick_interval] and [member flush_mode].

method.name: _script_process
method.description: GDScript override point, called when the system ticks. [param delta] is the time step in seconds. Reach the world via [method get_world_node].

method.name: get_system_name
method.description: Returns the system's name (the node name).

method.name: get_world_node
method.description: Returns the owning [VECSWorld] node (may be null for C++-only systems that never needed it).

method.name: handle
method.description: Scheduler entry point: dispatches to the script override [method _script_process] or the C++ [code]_tick[/code] virtual. Called automatically by the scheduler; you normally do not call it directly.

method.name: set_world_node
method.description: Injects the owning [VECSWorld] node. Called by the scheduler when the system is registered.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], the scheduler skips this system entirely.
Controls when the deferred command buffer is flushed: [constant PER_SYSTEM] after every system, [constant PER_GROUP] once per group, or [constant MANUAL] only when you call it yourself.
The group this system belongs to; it only ticks when [method VECSWorld.process] is called with the same group name.
If [code]true[/code], the system is skipped while still remaining registered.
Minimum time (seconds) between two ticks; [code]0.0[/code] ticks every frame. Useful for throttling low-priority systems.

constants.constant: Flush the command buffer after this system runs.
Flush the command buffer once after the whole group runs.
Never auto-flush; the user flushes via [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush].
